 Kimi Antonelli in pole position for the title: "I'm going to try to win" 
 Valentin GLO 
 Published on 25 / 10 / 2026 at 00: 29 
 Comment 
 Kimi Antonelli in pole position in Austin. Photo: DPPI 
 In contention for the title this Sunday, Kimi Antonelli will start from the best position to try and secure his first championship as he will start from pole position in Texas.
 Will Kimi Antonelli be crowned world champion this Sunday? The Italian has his first match point this weekend in Austin, and the Mercedes driver has put himself in the best possible position to convert it: pole position. He set the fastest qualifying time, ahead of the Red Bulls of Max Verstappen and Isack Hadjar . Even better for the Bolognese driver, Lewis Hamilton ( Ferrari ) will start only fifth and George Russell (Mercedes) sixth.
 While a possible title also depends on the results of these two (5th or beyond for Hamilton, 9th or beyond for Russell), the essential condition for being champion in Texas is to win.
 “ I’m on pole, so of course I’m going to try to win tomorrow, but Max is very fast here,” Antonelli said after qualifying. “ He did an incredible job in qualifying. It won’t be easy. I’m going to try to get a good start and try to be in the lead coming out of the first corner and then find the pace, even though it will be very close. I’m very happy with today’s qualifying session. Q3 was very difficult with the wind. I’m happy to have managed to secure this pole position. ”
 This seventh pole position of Antonelli's career comes at a perfect time, as his previous one was at the Belgian Grand Prix in July. To find out if Antonelli will convert this pole position into a victory, or even a world title, tune in this Sunday from 21:00 PM (Paris time).
